title: License-check tooling (lint allow-list + pack metadata + locale verification)
context: From M1 the 100% license/disclaimer gate becomes automated, so this tooling validates each pack's metadata against its allow-list and fails on missing attribution/disclaimer, incompatible output license, or unverified/expired locale data. It runs in CI as full enforcement. It depends on the content schemas and license-000.
objective: Build license-check tooling that lints allow-list and pack metadata and enforces locale verification in CI.
acceptanceCriteria: Validates each pack's metadata against its allow-list/original-authorship records
Fails if attribution or the mandatory disclaimer is missing, if output license is incompatible with a source, or if the locale's emergency number is unverified/expired
Runs in CI as the automated 100% license/disclaimer gate from M1
Agent-neutral; documented usage and exit codes
